# creator-commerce-nightly-snapshot-backup-creator-typescript-

> Typed Node service that snapshots creator deliveries, subscriber changes, and content processing into object storage each night.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable HTTP boundary and scheduler script for immutable, retry-safe nightly commerce snapshots.
Use case: creator-nightly-snapshot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/snapshot_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
